alt: Before-and-after comparison showing full-face rejuvenation using combined dermal filler, anti wrinkle, skin resurfacing and collagen induction therapy.
body:
This transformation is achieved through a full-face rejuvenation plan, combining advanced dermal fillers, precision botulinum toxin, collagen induction therapy, and medical-grade resurfacing. 

Together, these treatments rebuild lost volume, soften deep lines, tighten the skin and restore natural contours while keeping the result beautifully authentic. 

This is our highest-level package — an ultra-comprehensive approach for clients wanting a meaningful, noticeable but still unmistakably natural rejuvenation.

alt: Before and after smile showing restored facial symmetry with targeted botulinum toxin treatment.
body:
Facial asymmetry is incredibly common, especially when smiling, and often comes from overactive muscles, past nerve changes, or natural anatomical imbalance. 

Using precise, millimetre-accurate placement of botulinum toxin, we gently relax the dominant muscles so the smile sits in a more harmonious, natural position without freezing expression. 

The result is soft, elegant symmetry that restores balance and confidence, with improvements usually visible within 10–14 days.

alt: Before-and-after image of a man showing results from a non-surgical facelift using dermal fillers and wrinkle-relaxing injections, including nose lift, jawline contouring and lip support.
body:
This result was achieved using full-face dermal filler artistry combined with targeted wrinkle-relaxing injections to restore structure, balance and youthful definition. 

His treatment included a non-surgical nose lift, jawline contouring, lip support, chin refinement and correction of the DAO pull, creating a smoother, lifted and naturally refreshed appearance. 

The approach is bespoke to each face — rebuilding lost volume, softening heaviness and enhancing key features without changing who you are.

alt: Before-and-after image of a man showing reduced forehead lines and softened glabella frown lines after wrinkle-relaxing injections.
body:
This transformation shows targeted wrinkle-relaxing injections to the forehead and glabella (the “11s”), softening deep expression lines and preventing them from etching into the skin. 

The result is a naturally smoother, fresher look while keeping his facial expressions balanced and masculine. 

Treatment is tailored to his muscle strength and movement patterns to ensure a refined yet natural finish.

alt: Before-and-after close-up of a man showing reduced under-eye puffiness and smoother lower eyelids after a fluid-retention reduction treatment.
body:
This treatment targets morning swelling and fluid retention under the eyes, reducing puffiness and softening the tired look that can appear after sleep. 

It works by improving lymphatic drainage and relaxing specific muscles that trap fluid in this area. Results look natural and refreshed. 

This treatment is not suitable for true herniated fat pads, which present as constant bulging throughout the day and require a different approach.

alt: Before-and-after close-up of lips showing a subtle lift and smoother upper lip after a lip flip treatment.
body:
A lip flip gently relaxes the upper lip muscles so the lip can roll outward, creating a softer, fuller appearance without adding volume. 

Results stay natural and expressive while giving the mouth a fresher, more youthful look.

alt: Before-and-after close-up of a male jawline showing improved definition and a stronger, more sculpted contour after dermal filler.
body:
This treatment enhances the natural angles of the male jaw, adding structure, balance, and clean definition with expertly placed dermal filler. 

By strengthening the mandibular angle, refining the jawline, and improving symmetry, we create a sharper, more masculine profile while keeping everything completely natural and proportional to the face.

alt: Before-and-after image of a man showing improved cheek support and sharper jawline definition after dermal filler.

This treatment enhances overall facial balance by subtly lifting the mid-face and refining the jawline for a smoother, more structured profile. 

Carefully placed dermal filler restores lost volume, supports the cheeks, and sharpens lower-face definition — all while keeping the result soft, natural, and masculine.

This transformation restores harmony across the whole face using a personalised blend of dermal fillers, targeted muscle relaxation, and injectable skin hydrators for the neck. 

Volume is replaced where it’s naturally lost, contours are subtly lifted, and fine details — including lips, jawline, and lower-face shadows — are softened for a fresher, brighter, beautifully rejuvenated result.

alt: Before-and-after image of a man with facial asymmetry showing improved balance, smoother lines, and restored jawline definition after combined dermal filler and targeted muscle-relaxing treatment.

This front-on result showcases advanced symmetry correction and full-face rejuvenation. 

After facial nerve damage left one side of the face overactive and the other side weakened, we used targeted muscle relaxation and precise dermal filler placement to restore balance, soften asymmetries, smooth lines, and rebuild key facial structures. Small refined adjustments across the jawline, chin, lips, and mid-face created a natural, confident, and harmonious outcome.

alt: This angled view highlights the structural improvements achieved through advanced symmetry correction and full-face restoration.

alt: Before-and-after image of an older woman showing a full non-surgical facial rejuvenation with improved volume, smoother contours, reduced shadows, and a lifted, refreshed appearance.

This transformation shows the power of a full non-surgical face lift using our Full Works ULTRA approach — a carefully balanced combination of full-face dermal filler, structural support, and detailed refinement.

alt: Before-and-after close-up of an older woman showing dramatic improvement in deep facial folds, skin texture, brightness, and overall facial rejuvenation after full-face dermal filler and advanced skin resurfacing.

This transformation combines our Full Works ULTRA with the Perfect Skin Package to create one of the most dramatic yet natural results we’ve ever achieved. 

Deep creasing, volume loss, and skin laxity were corrected with a full-face lifting approach, while collagen induction therapy and a deep chemical peel rebuilt the skin’s texture from the inside out.

alt: Side-profile before-and-after of an older woman showing restored jawline contour and improved definition after dermal filler treatment.

This treatment focused on restoring a clean, structural jawline after significant age-related volume loss. 

Using advanced dermal filler techniques, we rebuilt the lower-face contour to create smoother transitions, a firmer edge, and a more youthful profile without adding heaviness. 

The result is a naturally lifted jawline that looks sharper, lighter, and beautifully supported while keeping every feature true to her face.

alt: Before-and-after close-up of an older woman’s temple and eye area showing restored volume, smoother contours, and improved facial balance after temple filler.
body:
This advanced treatment targeted hollowing in the temples — one of the biggest giveaways of ageing and facial imbalance. 

By restoring gentle volume in this area, we softened the upper face, rebalanced the eyebrow position, and removed the “peanut-shape” appearance that can happen when the temples sink inward. 

The result is an undetectably rejuvenated look: smoother, rounder contours, brighter eyes, and a face that feels naturally supported without looking filled.

alt: Side-profile before-and-after of a woman showing subtle lip filler enhancement with natural fullness and balanced shape.
body:
This subtle lip enhancement was designed to look completely undetectable — just a softer, fuller, naturally hydrated version of her own lips. 

Over the course of a year, we’ve refined her shape little by little, maintaining perfect proportions, a gentle lift to the Cupid’s bow, and seamless side-profile balance. 

The result is beautifully natural: no heaviness, no projection, no “filler look” — simply lips that suit her face effortlessly.

alt: Front-view before-and-after of subtle lip filler correcting a natural M-shape while maintaining a soft, natural contour.
body:
This gentle enhancement focused on refining her natural “M-shape” — a feature that can be beautiful, but not everyone prefers it. 

With careful shaping and subtle volumising, we softened the central dip, restored symmetry, and created a smoother, fuller contour while keeping everything looking completely authentic. 

The result is harmonious and natural: her own lips, just more balanced, hydrated, and confidently shaped.

alt: Before-and-after image showing subtle lip filler used to refine a natural M-shape and create soft, balanced volume.
body:
This treatment gently softened her natural M-shape while keeping her lips looking completely authentic and youthful. 

A touch of carefully placed filler restored symmetry, added subtle central volume, and smoothed out the contour without altering her unique lip character. 

The outcome is beautifully balanced, hydrated, and natural — the kind of enhancement that no one can quite place, but everyone notices.

alt: Before-and-after image of an elderly woman showing full-face rejuvenation with restored volume, softened under-eye hollows, improved cheek support, and smoother overall skin tone.
body:
This transformation is the result of a highly tailored full-face rejuvenation for a woman in her late 80s who had experienced significant natural volume loss over time. 

Through a combination of dermal filler (around 20ml), targeted skin treatments, deep chemical peeling, and precise contour support, we rebuilt the underlying structure of the midface, softened the hollowing at the temples, reduced heavy under-eye shadows, and restored gentle fullness through the cheeks and mouth area (Full Works ULTRA Package).

While no treatment can erase decades of ageing in a single stage, this approach brought her facial proportions back into harmony—lifting, smoothing, and brightening in a way that looks beautifully authentic. 

The outcome is not a different face, but her face… simply years lighter, healthier, and more supported.

He wanted his lips to look a little more balanced, not bigger — so we combined a precise lip flip with a small amount of dermal filler to gently bring the lip forward. Nothing rushed, nothing exaggerated.

Our focus was harmony. By working with his natural anatomy, we softened the profile and improved definition while keeping everything unmistakably masculine.

The result is effortless and believable — the kind of change where the after looks completely natural, and the before simply looks unfinished.

This client wanted just one thing addressed — the deep crease in her chin that had begun to age the lower face. Rather than a single-layer approach, we treated the area holistically to restore a smooth, rested appearance.

We used flat blanching dermal filler at the surface to gently push the crease outward, combined with deeper structural support along the bony fossa beneath the lower teeth. A small amount of anti-wrinkle treatment to the mentalis muscle helped relax the downward pull contributing to the crease.

The result is subtle but powerful — a softer, smoother chin that looks naturally refreshed and noticeably younger, without altering her features or expression.

alt: Before and after side-profile view showing natural chin projection enhancement using dermal filler and anti-wrinkle treatment to improve facial balance and profile harmony.
body:
This chin was built carefully over two sessions to achieve a result that looks effortless and completely natural. We used a firmer, structural dermal filler for projection, alongside a small amount of anti-wrinkle treatment to the mentalis muscle to allow the filler to settle undisturbed.

Two weeks after relaxing the muscle, we placed the first syringe and allowed it to integrate fully before refining the result with a second syringe six weeks later. The outcome is a beautifully balanced side profile with soft, elegant projection — nothing artificial, just natural harmony. A subtle lip tweak completed the profile, and she was absolutely delighted with the result.

alt: Before and after cheek acne scarring improvement using collagen induction therapy, showing smoother skin texture after three microneedling sessions on deeper skin tones.
body:
This client came to us with long-standing, deeply pitted acne scarring across the cheeks, dating back to childhood. With his skin tone, it was especially important to choose a treatment approach that prioritised safety, controlled stimulation, and pigment protection.

Jenna treated him with a carefully planned course of Collagen Induction Therapy, completing three sessions spaced five weeks apart. By working gradually and precisely, we were able to stimulate collagen production without triggering post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation or unwanted texture changes.

The improvement speaks for itself — around an 80–85% reduction in visible scarring, with smoother texture and healthier-looking skin overall. The client was thrilled with the results and chose to continue with maintenance treatments.

alt: Before and after male anti-wrinkle treatment showing softened forehead and eye-area lines with natural, masculine results.
body:
This client wanted to soften forehead and eye-area lines without losing expression or masculinity. We focused on precise, conservative placement to relax the muscles just enough to smooth the skin while keeping his face strong, open, and natural.

We specialise in anti-wrinkle treatments for men, using tailored dosing and advanced techniques that respect male anatomy. By working with premium B’tox and understanding muscle balance, we achieve longer-lasting results without heaviness, stiffness, or a feminised look.

The result is a fresher, more rested appearance — one that still looks exactly like him, just well slept and quietly rejuvenated.

alt: Lip enhancement planning and result showing precise anatomical markings used to create natural, balanced lips with dermal filler.
body:
This image shows the planning stage behind one of our natural lip enhancements. Before a single drop of filler is placed, we carefully map the lips to understand movement, balance, and proportion — because beautiful lips are built with intention, not volume.

Rather than “filling”, we design. Every marking reflects a decision about support, shape, and longevity, ensuring the filler integrates naturally with the tissue and continues to look elegant as time passes, without migration or distortion.

This client wanted lips that felt like hers, just better balanced and softly enhanced. The result was a natural, harmonious outcome — and a very happy patient.

This client had a long-standing brow asymmetry caused by a stronger pull on her anatomical left side, something that had bothered her since childhood. She had previously been offered surgical correction at significant cost, with the risk of an over-lifted, permanently surprised appearance.

Instead, we corrected the imbalance in a single session using advanced anti-wrinkle techniques. By carefully relaxing specific muscle groups, we were able to bring the brow down and restore symmetry while preserving her natural expression.

The result is soft, balanced, and completely natural — and most importantly, it finally allowed her to see the face she’d always felt she had. She was absolutely over the moon.

alt: Before and immediately after non-surgical full face rejuvenation using advanced dermal filler and anti-wrinkle techniques to restore facial structure while preserving natural expression.
body:
This client underwent a comprehensive non-surgical facelift using advanced dermal filler techniques and targeted anti-wrinkle injections, while carefully preserving her natural facial character. Over the course of the treatment, we rebuilt key structural support across the face — including the zygomatic arches, midface, pyriform aperture, lips, jawline, and temples — restoring balance and softening age-related collapse.

Importantly, the forehead was deliberately not treated with anti-wrinkle injections. Due to a hypertrophic muscular pull, treating this area would have risked brow descent and upper eyelid hooding. This decision-making is critical in advanced facial rejuvenation and highlights the importance of anatomical expertise over routine protocols.

The image shown on the right is taken immediately post-procedure, with visible swelling that will continue to soften as the filler integrates. As healing progresses, results will appear even more natural — refreshed, supported, and recognisably her.

alt: Before and after showing a natural facial refresh using subtle dermal filler and anti-wrinkle injections to improve balance and create a rested appearance.
body:
This treatment focused on gentle, well-placed enhancements to refresh the face without changing her natural features. We carried out a small amount of anti-wrinkle treatment in the forehead, crow’s feet, and DAOs to soften expression while maintaining movement.

Dermal filler was used conservatively in the piriform area and chin to restore balance and support, creating a smoother profile and improved facial harmony. The result is a fresh, healthy appearance that still looks completely like her — just more rested.

alt: Before and after showing conservative gummy smile correction using staged anti-wrinkle injections to gently reduce excessive gum show.
body:
This client was treated for a gummy smile using a careful, staged approach over three sessions. Rather than lowering the smile too quickly, we adjusted the muscle activity gradually over six weeks to allow the result to settle naturally and remain fully within the client’s comfort zone.

Targeted anti-wrinkle injections were placed primarily into the levator labii superioris alaeque nasi muscle, gently reducing excessive lift while preserving expression. There was still scope to lower the smile further, but the client was happy at this point — and that’s exactly where we stopped.

The result is tasteful, balanced, and long-lasting, with a smile that looks completely natural and still feels like hers.

alt: Before and after showing a bespoke thread lift to the jowl area using premium Korean PDO threads for natural facial lifting.
body:
Every thread lift we perform is completely bespoke, designed around the individual anatomy and degree of laxity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. 

In this case, carefully placed threads were used to lift and support the jowl area, restoring a cleaner, more youthful lower face contour.

We exclusively use high-quality PDO threads manufactured in Korea — where thread lifting was originally developed and refined. These threads are produced by one of the largest and most trusted medical thread manufacturers used by doctors across South Korea. 

We deliberately avoid lower-grade threads commonly sourced elsewhere, as thread quality directly affects safety, longevity, and results.

The outcome is a natural lift with no over-tightening, maintaining facial expression while achieving a noticeable yet refined improvement.

alt: Overhead before and after showing temple filler re-volumisation to restore upper facial balance and soften temple hollowing.
body:
his overhead angle is one of the clearest ways to demonstrate true temple hollowing — how volume loss here can narrow the upper face, exaggerate cheekbones, and subtly age the overall profile. 

We restored volume using approximately one and a half syringes per side, carefully placed to soften the depression and rebalance the upper face. Temple work is never charged per syringe at our clinic — we work on a fixed-price basis, allowing us to use whatever volume is required in that session to achieve the correct result, without compromise.

Temple re-volumisation is a highly advanced treatment and is performed exclusively by the Clinical Director. When done correctly, it opens the eye area, restores youthful proportions, and brings harmony back to the face in a way that feels natural, elegant, and completely unnoticeable.

alt: Front-on before and after showing a mid and lower face thread lift reducing jowls and restoring a fresher, lifted appearance.
body:
This client came to us concerned about jowling and general facial sagging that was starting to dull her features. We performed a combined mid-face and lower-face thread lift, carefully designed to lift, support, and restore structure while keeping her expression completely natural (fixed price - no extra charge per thread).

The after image was taken immediately post-procedure, so a small amount of swelling is still present — even so, you can clearly see the reduction in jowls, softened shadowing, and a fresher, more youthful facial shape.

At The Gorgeous Clinic, thread lifts are never rushed. Clients are booked for a full two-hour appointment, with proper local anaesthetic, time, comfort, and care. Every thread lift is bespoke, using only premium Korean threads — the highest quality available — because this is how safe, long-lasting, beautiful results are achieved.

This result was achieved using a precise combination of dermal filler and B'Tx to soften perioral lip lines without restricting natural movement. 

A subtle lip enhancement was added to restore balance and support the surrounding tissue, creating a smoother, refreshed appearance while keeping the lips natural and expressive. We generally recommend a subtle lip enhancement when treating perioral lines to avoid the lips turning inward (keep the volume balanced in and out of the lip)

alt: A powerful depigmentation peel used to safely restore brightness and even skin tone following pigmentation changes caused by medical treatment.
body:
This client experienced significant hyperpigmentation around the mouth following chemotherapy. Due to her skin type and pigmentation risk, a deep TCA peel was not clinically appropriate.

Instead, we performed a deep depigmentation peel specifically designed to target pigment pathways safely in higher-risk skin types. Five weeks post-treatment, the skin tone was visibly brighter, more even, and restored to its natural colour, with improved texture and radiance.

This result highlights the importance of correct peel selection, medical oversight, and tailored protocols — particularly in clients with complex medical histories.

alt: Multiple angle before and after images showing improvement in perioral hyperpigmentation after a deep depigmentation peel
body:
These images show additional angles of the same client following a deep depigmentation peel, performed to address pronounced hyperpigmentation around the mouth after chemotherapy.

Due to her skin type and increased risk of pigment disturbance, a deep TCA peel was contraindicated. Instead, a specialist depigmentation peel was selected to safely interrupt pigment production while protecting the skin barrier.

At five weeks post-treatment, the perioral area shows a clear return to a more even, natural skin tone, with improved brightness and overall harmony across the lower face. This case highlights the importance of correct peel selection and medical expertise when treating complex pigmentation.

alt: Before and after images of a male patient showing full facial reconstruction using dermal filler, skin treatments, and collagen stimulation
body:
This client presented with advanced facial ageing, including significant loss of bone support, depleted fat pads, and extremely thin skin with minimal collagen and elastin remaining.

A carefully planned combination approach was used, including structural dermal filler to reconstruct the cheeks and support the mid-face, subtle lip restoration for balance, and an intensive skin programme incorporating chemical peels and polylactic acid (PLLA) to stimulate collagen regeneration.

The result is a face that looks stronger, healthier, and more youthful, while remaining completely natural. Despite the amount of work involved, nothing appears artificial — just a restored version of himself with improved skin quality, structure, and definition.

alt: Fat dissolving client after resutls, reduced waist measurement
body:
Our client booked in for 3 sessions of fat dissolving injections in his lower abdomen and flanks based on our clinicians recommendation. 

Below are the results he achieved, when combining the treatment with a healthy water intake and moderate, consistent exercise to aid in the removal of the dissolved fat cells. 

Waist Measurements:

1 month after 1st session: 33.8"
1 month after 2nd session: 31.2"
1 month after 3rd session: 29"

Our client lost an incredible 4.8" from his waist, and this wasn't even the final result - swelling and inflammation was still present. 

This was all with a non-surgical, 45 minute procedure once a month.

alt: Before and after full-face rejuvenation showing softer under-eye bags, smoother nasolabial folds, and a fresher, lifted expression

This result came from a carefully planned combination approach, using under-eye filler, nasolabial support, and subtle structural filler through the lateral cheek to restore lost support without overfilling.

We also used precisely placed botulinum toxin through the forehead, glabella, and DAO area to soften tension, open the expression, and create a fresher, more lifted overall look.

alt: Before and after full-face rejuvenation showing restored cheek volume, softer under-eyes, smoother lines, and a fresher natural facial structure

alt: Before and after non-surgical thread lift showing subtle lifting through the jowls and lower face with a natural refreshed result
body:

The jowl and cheek area were gently elevated to a higher, more youthful position, while keeping her natural facial character completely intact. The procedure was carried out slowly under local anaesthetic in controlled clinical conditions, making it far more comfortable than many people expect.

The after photo was taken with a little swelling still present from treatment and anaesthetic, so the settled result becomes even softer and more refined as everything calms down.

alt: Before and after full-face rejuvenation showing restored volume, softer facial lines, and a natural lifted result following advanced non-surgical treatment
body:
This was a highly bespoke full-face rejuvenation, using carefully placed dermal filler from the temples down to the chin, alongside strategic B-tox, to restore lost support, soften lines, and rebuild the face in a beautifully natural way.

Every area was assessed anatomically, with volume restored at multiple levels to recreate youthful structure rather than simply “filling” isolated features. Fine lines were also treated with precision, allowing the whole face to look fresher, smoother, and more lifted without losing character.

The after photo was taken with some swelling still present, yet the result is already striking. Every face is treated as its own piece of art by the Clinical Director — never rushed, never templated, always sculpted around the client’s unique anatomy for a refined and deeply personal result.

alt: Before and after full-face rejuvenation showing the settled two-week result with natural lip enhancement, softer lines, and a fresher youthful appearance
body:
This image shows the settled result around two and a half weeks after treatment, once the early swelling had faded and everything had softened into place. It beautifully demonstrates how our lip enhancements settle at The Gorgeous Clinic — smooth, natural, and completely in harmony with the rest of the face.

This was part of a wider full-face transformation using carefully placed dermal filler and B-tox to restore structure, soften lines, and create a fresher, more lifted appearance without sacrificing natural character.

The result was so powerful for this client that it changed how she felt in herself entirely. She looked younger, dressed younger, felt younger, and even became emotional during the interview we filmed with her — which clients can watch over on our social media.

alt: Before and after advanced glabella filler treatment showing significant softening of deep static frown lines
body:
These deep glabella lines had been etched into the skin over many years, meaning B-tox alone would never fully remove them once they were present at rest. We first quietened the underlying muscle movement, then conservatively re-volumised the creases themselves with precisely placed dermal filler.

This is one of the most technically demanding areas of the face to treat well, which is why it should only be approached by a highly experienced medical injector with advanced upper-face training and a very controlled technique.

The result is a visibly smoother, fresher glabella without heaviness or distortion — just a more rested expression achieved with precision, restraint, and clinical expertise.

alt: Before and after advanced under-eye rejuvenation showing smoother orbital rim support and a brighter more rested eye area
body:
This result was achieved by carefully restoring volume at the orbital rim itself, replacing the deeper structural support that had been lost over time through natural bony reabsorption. Rather than placing superficial filler into the tear trough, we rebuilt the area at bone level to create a smoother, more natural transition beneath the eyes.

This is a highly advanced area to treat well, requiring detailed anatomical understanding, precise technique, and a very controlled medical approach. When performed correctly, it can dramatically refresh the eyes without creating puffiness, heaviness, or an obvious “filled” look.

The after image was taken around three weeks later, once the area had settled. The result is bright, smooth, and beautifully natural — with the eyes looking far more awake and the entire face appearing fresher.

alt: Before and after advanced under-eye correction showing smoother medial orbital rim support after dissolving previous filler
body:
This client had previously been treated elsewhere with tear trough filler, but the result had not settled in a natural or flattering way. We first dissolved the old product completely, then rebuilt the area properly using our more advanced approach to restore support at the medial orbital rim itself.

By replacing lost structure at a deeper anatomical level, rather than relying on superficial filler placement, we achieved a smoother, fresher, and far more natural transition beneath the eyes.

The result is brighter, softer, and beautifully refined — proof that under-eye rejuvenation can look incredibly elegant when the anatomy is respected and the area is treated with precision.

alt: Before and after bespoke lip enhancement showing increased lip height, refined shape, and a fuller glossy result without excessive forward projection
body:
This lip enhancement was designed around the client’s natural anatomy and aesthetic goals, using a more advanced vertical approach to create height and definition without pushing the lips too far forwards. For this client, that was the key to achieving a fuller result that still felt elegant, balanced, and in harmony with her features.

Using a slightly firmer dermal filler and a highly tailored technique, we increased the visible lip show and refined the overall shape while keeping the result soft, classy, and bespoke to her face.

The after photo was taken with swelling still present, but even immediately after treatment the structure is beautiful. This is exactly why every lip enhancement in clinic is individually planned rather than forced into one standard style.

alt: Before and after nasolabial fold treatment showing softer nose to mouth lines and natural facial movement following advanced piriform support
body:
This client’s main concern was deepening through the lines running from the nose to the mouth. Rather than placing filler directly into the fold in a heavy or superficial way, we restored support at the piriform fossa using a deeper anatomical approach to soften the area more naturally.

By placing the dermal filler beneath the muscle, we were able to improve the fold without weighing down the smile or distorting movement. The mouth still animates beautifully, because the structure has been supported properly rather than simply filled over.

The result is subtle, fresh, and very natural — a beautiful example of how good anatomy and careful technique can turn back the clock without making the face look treated.

alt: Before and after nasolabial fold treatment showing softened nose to mouth lines following deep piriform structural support
body:
This result was achieved using our deeper structural approach to the piriform region, restoring support at bone level rather than placing weight into the fold itself or in a more superficial plane influenced by mouth movement.

By supporting the area more anatomically, we can soften the nose-to-mouth lines while keeping the smile natural and avoiding the heavy look that can happen when product sits too close to active muscular animation. It also helps reduce the chance of the filler being pushed laterally over time.

The result is smoother, fresher, and far more elegant — a beautiful example of how respecting anatomy can create a more natural long-term correction.

alt: PDO tightening threads being placed into the lower cheek and chin to improve crepey skin, tighten laxity, and refine the lower face contour
body:
This image shows PDO tightening threads being placed through the lower face, where they are used to improve crepey skin, refine laxity, and gently pull the tissues inwards for a firmer, more supported look. In the cheeks, this can create a subtle contouring effect, while through the chin it helps tighten and smooth the skin beautifully.

Although the treatment can look dramatic mid-procedure, it is usually far more comfortable than clients expect thanks to the strong numbing cream we use beforehand. PDO tightening threads are not a thread lift — they are designed to create refinement, collagen support, and elegant tightening rather than a heavy mechanical lift.

Bruising can happen and varies from person to person, particularly with age, skin fragility, or certain medications, but many clients heal with surprisingly little downtime. The result is a fresher, tighter, more polished lower face without surgery.

alt: Before and after non-surgical face lift showing improved facial symmetry, restored volume, and a brighter more balanced result three weeks after treatment
body:
This beautiful result was achieved with a highly bespoke non-surgical face lift, focused on restoring symmetry, refining old irregularities, and rebuilding the face in a way that still looked soft, fresh, and completely natural. Over three hours, the face was carefully rebalanced with advanced structural support and subtle finishing work, including attention to areas affected by asymmetry and previous scarring.

This client had originally been treated by us around two years earlier, with some support still remaining through areas such as the temple and mid-cheek. At this visit, we refreshed and refined the face again, restoring brightness, balance, and a far more polished overall appearance without losing her identity.

The after image was taken around three weeks later, once most of the swelling had settled. A little residual swelling remained in a few areas, such as the lips, but the result is already beautifully clear — lifted, harmonious, and full of life.
